name: Grave Bite
description: Bite into a soul already marked for its end and draw out the last of its force.

name: Ashen Taste
description: Taste the ashen edge of a failing soul to learn how soon it will end.

name: Pall Husk
description: Draw a pall of dying force about the soul that eats a strike meant for the living core.

name: Ending Chain
description: Chain the foe's soul to its own ending so that every struggle brings the end nearer.

name: Wither Fang
description: Drive a fang that withers whatever it touches through the foe's guard to the core.

name: Breath Purge
description: Eat the creeping cold of death from an ally's soul and leave it warm.

name: Dying Feast
description: Gorge on a dying soul and feed the user with the force that would have been lost.

name: Pallid Famine
description: Spread a pallid famine over a company so that every soul within it fades.

name: Terminal Absorption
description: Absorb the last force of a dying soul in reach and strike another with the whole of it.

name: Silence Devoured
description: streams: Devour Soul + Death; eat a soul in the instant it ends so that nothing of it remains to pass on.

name: Qi Maw
description: Strike with a fist of qi that carries a maw of soul force and bites as it lands.

name: Fused Taste
description: Taste with the body and the soul together to judge both flesh and spirit of a foe.

name: Unity Husk
description: Wear a husk of qi over the soul that eats the force of a strike aimed at either.

name: Imprint Sip
description: Sip the force drawn by a strike and imprint it on the qi of the arm.

name: Imprinted Chain
description: Chain the foe's body and soul together with qi so that neither can move without the other.

name: Imprinted Fang
description: Drive a fang of qi and soul together through a guard of either kind.

name: Qi Siphon
description: Draw the foe's qi and his soul force into one siphon and spoil his technique.

name: Unity Cleansing
description: Eat a stain from an ally's meridians and soul at once and leave both clean.

name: Unity Feast
description: Gorge on body and soul together and restore the user's meridians and soul in one pull.

name: Unity Famine
description: Spread a famine of qi and soul over a company that starves both at once.

name: Unity Consumption
description: Absorb an attack of qi or soul and answer by consuming both from the foe.

name: Unified Hunger
description: streams: Devour Soul + Qi; make every technique of the user feed on what it strikes in flesh and soul at once.
